preconditions.description: The target currency must be either 'USD' or 'EUR'.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, (int, float)) for x in values_list)
preconditions.description: All elements in values_list must be numeric (int or float).
All amounts in values_list must be non-negative.

postconditions.description: The output list must have the same length as the input values_list.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, str) for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(',' in x for x in return_value) and all('.00' in x for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each output string must contain a comma (for thousands separator) and exactly two decimal places.

postconditions.expression: all('USD' in x or '€' in x for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each output string must end with either '$' (for USD) or '€' (for EUR).

postconditions.expression: all('€' in x if to_currency == 'EUR' else '$' in x for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: The currency symbol in each output string must match the target currency.

postconditions.expression: all(''.join(c for c in x if c.isdigit() or c in ('.', ',')) == format(round(sum([v * 1.1363636 if to_currency == 'USD' else v / 1.1363636 for v in values_list]), 2), ',.2f').replace('.', '', 1) for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each output string must represent the correctly converted and rounded amount (to 2 decimal places) with proper formatting for the target currency.
